import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import time


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    TRAIN_PATH = "./input/en_train.csv"
    TEST_PATH = "./input/en_test_2.csv"
    SUBMIT_DIR = "./submission/"
    os.makedirs(SUBMIT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    print("Loading training data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv(
        TRAIN_PATH, usecols=["before", "after", "sentence_id", "token_id"]
    )
    print("Loading test data...")
    test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH, usecols=["before", "sentence_id", "token_id"])

    # Safely handle types and whitespace without corrupting punctuation
    train_df["before"] = train_df["before"].astype(str).str.strip()
    train_df["after"] = train_df["after"].astype(str).str.strip()
    test_df["before"] = test_df["before"].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Fix <self> tokens: replace with original before token
    self_mask = train_df["after"] == "<self>"
    train_df.loc[self_mask, "after"] = train_df.loc[self_mask, "before"]

    # Sentence-level hold-out split (10%) to prevent data leakage and reduce variance
    print("Creating hold-out validation split...")
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    unique_sentences = train_df["sentence_id"].drop_duplicates()
    val_sent_count = max(1, int(0.10 * len(unique_sentences)))
    val_sents = set(
        rng.choice(unique_sentences.values, size=val_sent_count, replace=False)
    )

    val_df = train_df[train_df["sentence_id"].isin(val_sents)].reset_index(drop=True)
    train_model = train_df[~train_df["sentence_id"].isin(val_sents)].reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    # Build mode mapping from strictly held-out training data
    print("Computing mode mapping...")
    mode_map = (
        train_model.groupby("before")["after"]
        .apply(lambda x: x.value_counts().index[0])
        .to_dict()
    )

    def predict(tokens):
        return tokens.map(mode_map).fillna(tokens)

    # Evaluate on hold-out set (model never saw these)
    print("Evaluating on hold-out set...")
    val_preds = predict(val_df["before"])
    acc = (val_preds == val_df["after"]).mean()
    print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {acc:.6f}")

    # Predict on test set
    print("Generating predictions on test set...")
    test_df["after"] = predict(test_df["before"])

    # Create submission
    sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str)
            + "_"
            + test_df["token_id"].astype(str),
            "after": test_df["after"],
        }
    )
    sub_path = os.path.join(SUBMIT_DIR, "submission.csv")
    sub_df.to_csv(sub_path, index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {sub_path} ({time.time()-t0:.1f}s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
